Primary request: One portrait source sheet, preferably 1024x1536 or larger native resolution, containing exactly EIGHT instances of the SAME small rounded pastel propeller airplane, arranged in exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows, with clear transparent gutters. Keep body upright, two antennae attached to the head, all four wing lobes represented, and generous transparent margin around the whole insect.
Invariants: same ordinary natural butterfly, same warm brown rounded contours and watercolor paper texture, same coral-orange wings, cream upper markings and gold/cream lower markings. No face, no eyes, no mouth, no eyebrows, no animal mascot, no hat, no clothing, no extra body segments, no long neck. No labels, text, border, ground, plants or opaque background.
